description: Click Speed Test — how many clicks per second can you manage? 5 or 10 second sprint with countdown.

faqs.a: Clicks per second = total clicks ÷ seconds. The test counts only clicks inside the arena while the timer runs.
Your best CPS for each duration (5s and 10s) is saved in your browser.
Most people tap 5–8 clicks per second with one finger; 10+ usually needs two fingers or a fast mouse.

howto: Wait for the 3-2-1 countdown — don't click early.
Click the arena as fast as you can until time's up.
See your clicks, CPS and best score.
title: Click Speed Test
